name: Swift Package Registry
auth: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN with matching subject and read/write repository permissions. The token is the Basic password in an explicit private netrc file. SwiftPM also requires a basic authentication entry for the registry host in registries.json. This recipe writes that configuration directly, without requiring a separate registry login API.
fresh_home: Use a new temporary AW_SWIFT_WORK for config, security state, netrc and caches, and fresh producer/consumer project directories. The tests run SwiftPM with an isolated home and explicit netrc/config paths; the remote/offline checks use distinct new consumer and cache directories.
prerequisites: Python 3 for safely generating host-keyed JSON and netrc configuration. AW_USER/AW_TOKEN must contain no whitespace.
A producer Swift package with Package.swift and source files. The consumer Package.swift declares a registry dependency such as .package(id: "acme.Widget", from: "1.0.0").
A trusted HTTPS registry endpoint; the local test fixture alone uses --allow-insecure-http.

configure.code:
export AW_SWIFT_WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
umask 077
mkdir -p "$AW_SWIFT_WORK/config" "$AW_SWIFT_WORK/security"
python3 - <<'PYCODE'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
root = Path(os.environ['AW_SWIFT_WORK'])
host = urlsplit(os.environ['AW_URL']).hostname
(root / 'client.netrc').write_text('machine %s login %s password %s\n' % (host, os.environ['AW_USER'], os.environ['AW_TOKEN']))
(root / 'client.netrc').chmod(0o600)
(root / 'config' / 'registries.json').write_text(json.dumps({'version': 1, 'registries': {}, 'authentication': {host: {'type': 'basic'}}}))
PYCODE
swift package-registry --package-path consumer --config-path "$AW_SWIFT_WORK/config" set "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/swift/$AW_REPO"
configure.note: Keep the netrc file private and untracked. The registry configuration contains only the authentication type, not the token.

publish.note: Native publication is proven on local and one-node federated repositories. No publication command is offered for remote or virtual repositories.

steps.note: Replace package identity/version with your producer. zip must be installed; SwiftPM builds the source archive itself.

install.note: Local, remote, virtual and one-node federated resolution use the same native registry URL. Virtual members and upstream origin policy remain administrator configuration.

steps.note: Start without a previous consumer .build or Package.resolved when proving a cold fetch. Keep signature and checksum validation enabled.

limitations: The native auth regression test rejects invalid credentials with HTTP 401 before publication and verifies the release was not created, then publishes/resolves with valid credentials. The real password verifier and route permission evaluator are used; access-token-as-Basic-password behavior is separately covered by the shared authenticator tests.
The pinned Linux CI lane exercises these registry auth/config flags. Local verification of the new authenticated flow used Swift 6.4.2. Xcode GUI/IDE setup is outside this CLI recipe.
Authentication format reference: https://docs.swift.org/latest/documentation/packagemanagerdocs/packageregistrylogin/ . Direct configuration avoids depending on an unimplemented login API.
